quests.title: Look to the right
quests.ask: Fill in `right_is_clear()`. With the wall right below, it should give back `False` and leave the robot where it was, facing the same way.
quests.nudge: After it looks, which way is the robot facing? Which way should it face?

quests.title: Follow the wall down
quests.ask: Write `step_along_wall()`, which takes one step with the wall on the right. Standing over a dip, the step should go down into it, ending facing down.
quests.nudge: If the wall drops away under your right hand, which way do you go to keep touching it?

quests.title: Follow the wall up
quests.ask: With the wall rising right in front, one `step_along_wall()` should take the robot up along it, ending facing up.
quests.nudge: What is different about this cell from the dip? What does the robot see on its right?

quests.title: A bump and a dip
quests.ask: On this short wall, use your step to follow it and collect every gem on the trail.
quests.nudge: If the robot gets lost, find the first step where it leaves the wall.
